title: Verify European conditional descriptor CLI
changes: Record production CLI creation, reuse and startup with the EUR e98-d97 conditional descriptor dataset.
validation: One isolated Windows build and one Wine create/reuse/startup sequence passed: 89 files match the accepted dataset, 88 runtime identities match, and managed files and guarded inputs remain unchanged.
limitations: The neutral frame had zero descriptor reads; ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
